channel.title: Biodiversity Synthesis Lab
channel.description: Lab of Diogo B. Provete at UFMS — community ecology, eco-evolutionary dynamics, freshwater metacommunities.

item.title: Not accepting new graduate students
item.description: As of August 2026, Diogo is not accepting new graduate students for the time being. Prospective students are welcome to get in touch about other opportunities or to check back in the future.

item.title: Welcome to João Barros
item.description: In July 2026, João Barros started working with us as an undergraduate research fellow (PIBIC).

item.title: Iara Coimbra and Beatriz Oliveira start independent undergraduate projects
item.description: Iara Coimbra has joined Beatriz Oliveira to conduct their independent undergraduate research projects. Both had their fellowships approved. Congratulations!

item.title: Bruna Maria joins the lab as a Master’s student
item.description: Bruna Maria has joined the lab as a Master’s student. She’ll be testing how multiple biodiversity facets of frogs respond to urbanisation in the Brazilian Atlantic Forest, using a macroecological approach.

item.title: Diogo awarded a FUNDECT research productivity grant
item.description: Diogo has been granted a FUNDECT research productivity grant. This small grant will allow us to keep funding field work conducted by our students.

item.title: Welcome to Ana Paula Andreazzi
item.description: We gave a warm welcome to Ana Paula Andreazzi, who joins the lab as a PhD student. Ana Paula will be testing how stingless bees respond to heat waves in urban ecosystems in the Tropics.
